title: South Florida Places Trying Way Too Hard To Be Miami
igCaption:
Fort Lauderdale got one crane on Las Olas and started charging Brickell feelings.
Who’s pretending the hardest: Lauderdale, Boca, or West Palm?
(satire)
#SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #BocaRaton #WestPalmBeach #MiamiComedy #FloridaComedy #LasOlas #MiznerPark #ClematisStreet #Brickell #SoFlo #FloridaTraffic

scenes.text: Fort Lauderdale people, you got one condo crane and started acting like Brickell. Number one gets me cursed out.

location.name: Las Olas Boulevard Bridge, Fort Lauderdale

scenes.text: Number three, Downtown West Palm. Last Saturday by Rosemary Square, I watched a guy pay nineteen dollars for parking to buy a twelve dollar iced coffee, then call it peaceful. Bro, Clematis at ten p.m. is three golf carts, one bachelorette sash, and a security guard whispering into his sleeve.
scenes.caption: Number 3, Downtown West Palm. Last Saturday by Rosemary Square, I watched a guy pay $19 for parking to buy a $12 iced coffee, then call it peaceful. Bro, Clematis at 10 p.m. is 3 golf carts, one bachelorette sash, and a security guard whispering into his sleeve.

scenes.text: Number two, Boca by Mizner Park. My aunt says it’s classy, then she circles the garage on Plaza Real for twenty-two minutes behind a Range Rover with no reverse lights. Every restaurant has one guy explaining his boat slip like it’s a medical degree. I respect it. Stay for number one, I’m dead serious.
scenes.caption: Number 2, Boca by Mizner Park. My aunt says it’s classy, then she circles the garage on Plaza Real for 22 minutes behind a Range Rover with no reverse lights. Every restaurant has one guy explaining his boat slip like it’s a medical degree. I respect it. Stay for number 1, I’m dead serious.

location.name: Mizner Park, Plaza Real, Boca Raton

scenes.text: And number one... Fort Lauderdale. I was on Federal Highway by Ruth’s Chris at Northeast twenty-sixth after that stupid rain, and a hero in a lifted truck hit the floodwater like he was docking in Bimini. The wake slapped a Corolla, the valet guy looked tired, and a crane down Las Olas kept spinning. Miami Junior.
